new_value: Implemented 4-state CCP desync recovery FSM (UNJOINED/JOINED/DRIFT/RECOVER) per spec 2a.6. Added CcpFSM class with correct transitions: UNJOINED->JOINED on join, JOINED->DRIFT on T_DRIFT_WARN, DRIFT->RECOVER on T_DRIFT_MAX, RECOVER->UNJOINED on T_GIVE_UP, and beacon-triggered recovery. Updated CcpState enum from 5 states to spec-compliant 4 states. Added 17 tests for state machine transitions.
